validation_procedure.accept_condition: zero rejection codes emitted across all stages

kind_predicates.string_array: Array.isArray(value) AND value.every(v => typeof v === "string" AND v.length > 0)

structural_checks.description: Packet root must be a JSON object.
structural_checks.predicate: typeof packet === "object" AND packet !== null AND !Array.isArray(packet)

structural_checks.description: Packet must contain the metadata and channels sections.
Packet must not carry sections beyond the declared required sections.
channels section must be an array of channel payloads.

metadata_checks.description: metadata.packet_id must be present (non-empty caller-assigned runtime identity).
metadata.packet_id must not be null.
metadata.packet_id must be of declared type string.
metadata.packet_version must be present (must equal v1).
metadata.packet_version must not be null.
metadata.packet_version must be of declared type string.
metadata.source_video_id must be present (non-empty certified corpus source id shared by every channel).
metadata.source_video_id must not be null.
metadata.source_video_id must be of declared type string.
metadata.spatial_frame_ref must be present (must equal normalized_image_plane_v1).
metadata.spatial_frame_ref must not be null.
metadata.spatial_frame_ref must be of declared type string.
metadata.timebase must be present (must equal milliseconds).
metadata.timebase must not be null.
metadata.timebase must be of declared type string.
metadata.contract_id must be present (must equal direct-spatial-conditioning-contract-v1).
metadata.contract_id must not be null.
metadata.contract_id must be of declared type string.
metadata.channel_count must be present (must equal 6).
metadata.channel_count must not be null.
metadata.channel_count must be of declared type integer.
metadata.packet_version must equal the specified packet version.
metadata.spatial_frame_ref must equal the locked spatial frame.
metadata.timebase must be milliseconds.
metadata.contract_id must reference the PHASE-031 conditioning contract.
metadata.channel_count must equal the declared channel cardinality.

cross_channel_checks.description: All six declared conditioning channels must be present.
No channel_id may appear more than once.
Channel sequence must follow the declared channel order.
Every channel source_video_id must equal metadata.source_video_id.
Every channel spatial_frame_ref must equal metadata.spatial_frame_ref.
metadata.channel_count must equal the number of channel payloads.
edit_rhythm_boundaries must carry one shot duration per cut boundary timestamp.

rejection_codes.description: Packet root is not a JSON object.
rejection_codes.remediation: Send an application/json object with metadata and channels sections.

rejection_codes.description: A required top-level section (metadata or channels) is absent.
rejection_codes.remediation: Include both required sections declared by the packet specification.

rejection_codes.description: Packet carries a top-level section outside the declared required sections.
rejection_codes.remediation: Remove sections not declared by the packet specification.

rejection_codes.description: channels section is not an array.
rejection_codes.remediation: Encode channels as an array of channel payload objects.

rejection_codes.description: A required metadata field is absent.
rejection_codes.remediation: Populate every metadata field declared by the packet specification.

rejection_codes.description: A required metadata field is null.
rejection_codes.remediation: Metadata fields are non-nullable; supply a concrete value.

rejection_codes.description: A metadata field violates its declared type.
rejection_codes.remediation: Match the declared metadata field type.

rejection_codes.description: metadata.packet_version does not equal the specified packet version.
rejection_codes.remediation: Set metadata.packet_version to v1.

rejection_codes.description: metadata.spatial_frame_ref does not equal the locked spatial frame.
rejection_codes.remediation: Set metadata.spatial_frame_ref to normalized_image_plane_v1.

rejection_codes.description: metadata.timebase is not milliseconds.
rejection_codes.remediation: Set metadata.timebase to milliseconds.

rejection_codes.description: metadata.contract_id does not reference the PHASE-031 conditioning contract.
rejection_codes.remediation: Set metadata.contract_id to direct-spatial-conditioning-contract-v1.

rejection_codes.description: metadata.channel_count does not equal the declared channel cardinality.
rejection_codes.remediation: Set metadata.channel_count to 6.

rejection_codes.description: Packet carries a channel_id outside the six declared channels.
rejection_codes.remediation: Send only the six declared conditioning channels.

rejection_codes.description: A required channel envelope field is absent.
rejection_codes.remediation: Populate every envelope field declared for the channel payload.

rejection_codes.description: A required channel envelope field is null.
rejection_codes.remediation: Envelope fields are non-nullable; supply a concrete value.

rejection_codes.description: Channel payload channel_id does not match its payload definition.
rejection_codes.remediation: Set channel_id to the channel the payload declares.

rejection_codes.description: Channel spatial_frame_ref does not equal the locked spatial frame.
rejection_codes.remediation: Set channel spatial_frame_ref to normalized_image_plane_v1.

rejection_codes.description: Channel timestamp_ms is not a finite number greater than or equal to zero.
rejection_codes.remediation: Send a finite non-negative millisecond timestamp.

rejection_codes.description: Channel source_video_id is empty or not a string.
rejection_codes.remediation: Send a non-empty certified corpus source id.

rejection_codes.description: Channel components is not a JSON object.
rejection_codes.remediation: Encode components as a JSON object keyed by component name.

rejection_codes.description: A declared component is absent from the channel components object.
rejection_codes.remediation: Supply every component declared for the channel.

rejection_codes.description: A declared component is null.
rejection_codes.remediation: Components are non-nullable; supply a concrete value.

rejection_codes.description: A component value violates its declared value kind.
rejection_codes.remediation: Match the component value kind declared by the packet specification.

rejection_codes.description: Channel components object carries a component outside the declared set.
rejection_codes.remediation: The component set is closed; remove undeclared components.

rejection_codes.description: Packet does not carry all six declared conditioning channels.
rejection_codes.remediation: Include every declared channel exactly once.

rejection_codes.description: A channel_id appears more than once in the packet.
rejection_codes.remediation: Send each channel exactly once.

rejection_codes.description: Channel sequence does not follow the declared channel order.
rejection_codes.remediation: Order channels as declared by the packet specification.

rejection_codes.description: Channel source_video_id values disagree with metadata.source_video_id.
rejection_codes.remediation: All channels must describe the same source video as the metadata.

rejection_codes.description: Channel spatial_frame_ref values disagree with metadata.spatial_frame_ref.
rejection_codes.remediation: All channels must share the metadata spatial frame.

rejection_codes.description: metadata.channel_count disagrees with the number of channel payloads sent.
rejection_codes.remediation: Keep metadata.channel_count equal to channels.length.

rejection_codes.description: edit_rhythm_boundaries cut_timestamp_ms and shot_duration_ms have different lengths.
rejection_codes.remediation: Send one duration per cut boundary.
